name.description: Kebab-case name of the complex component. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the dasherized node id.

path.description: Destination directory within the Angular application source tree.

project.description: Angular application project. Required when the workspace has multiple source roots.

features.description: Comma-separated feature list: mixins, nested, projection, cdk-overlay. Required unless --document is given; not allowed with --document.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a SurfaceContainers node into a Material card with header, content, and actions slots; children are compiled and embedded, and an OverlayContainers child adds the CDK overlay. Supports only --mode=create.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first SurfaceContainers element. Requires --document.
